title: Portrait Sweep Studio
description: One static portrait-studio scene from the original photography scene program. Three complete existing assets are reused at original scale: continuous sweep backdrop, tripod camera facing into its empty subject area, and softbox facing across that area from the right. A scene-only floor provides the shared layout. Original local POSITION/NORMAL, all materials and internal node hierarchies remain unchanged; only exact 0/180/-90 degree instance matrices and single-quantized translations place whole assets. One scene, zero new independent models. An empty illustrative set, not a portrait subject model, optical alignment or exposure simulation, lighting-performance, background compatibility, operator clearance, safe installation or functioning photography claim.
